faqs.question: Is BillsZilla really free?
faqs.answer: Yes — free forever, with no limits on the number of invoices, no watermark, and no account required.

faqs.question: Do I need to sign up?
faqs.answer: No. Everything works without an account. Your invoices are saved in your own browser's local storage.

faqs.question: Is my business data private?
faqs.answer: Yes. All invoice data is processed locally in your browser. Nothing is uploaded to any server.

faqs.question: Can I make a GST invoice?
faqs.answer: Yes. Choose the GST tax mode and enter the GST % per line item. BillsZilla splits CGST/SGST for intra-state invoices and shows IGST for inter-state ones.

faqs.question: Which currencies and languages are supported?
faqs.answer: Over 50 currencies including PKR, INR, AED, SAR, USD, EUR and GBP. Invoices can be generated in English, Spanish, French, German, Portuguese, Arabic, Hindi and Urdu — Arabic and Urdu use proper right-to-left layout.

faqs.question: How do I download my invoice as PDF?
faqs.answer: Click “Download PDF” — your browser's print dialog opens with the invoice formatted for A4. Choose “Save as PDF” and you're done.

faqs.question: Will my saved invoices sync across devices?
faqs.answer: Saved invoices live in the browser you created them in. Because there's no account and no server, they don't sync across devices — that's the trade-off for total privacy.
